title: Can Spectral-Clipping Enable Better Learning While Forgetting Less for Low-Rank Adaptation?
abstract: arXiv:2608.12332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a significant paradigm that freezes pre-trained weights and introduces small, learnable adapters instead of fine-tuning the full set of parameters. In this work, we uncover several key insights regarding the singular components of network parameters based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Firstly, the principal singular components with large singular values in pre-trained network parameters can be effectively reused during fine-tuning, whereas the minor components with smaller singular values are more task-specific and require substantial adaptation. Secondly, we first establish the theoretical connection that the uncontrolled growth of singular values in LoRA adapters leads to the forgetting of pre-trained knowledge -- a well-known issue referred to as catastrophic forgetting. Building on these observations, we propose SCLoRA, which injects parameterized singular components

translated_title: 频谱裁剪能否在低秩适应中实现更好的学习同时减少遗忘？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12332v1 公告类型：新  摘要：近年来，低秩适应（LoRA）已成为一种重要范式，它冻结预训练权重，并引入小型可学习适配器，而不是微调全部参数。在这项工作中，我们基于奇异值分解（SVD）揭示了网络参数奇异分量的几个关键见解。首先，预训练网络参数中具有大奇异值的主奇异分量可以在微调过程中被有效重用，而具有较小奇异值的次分量更具任务特异性，需要大量调整。其次，我们首次建立了理论联系，即LoRA适配器中奇异值的无控制增长会导致预训练知识的遗忘——这是众所周知的问题，称为灾难性遗忘。基于这些观察，我们提出了SCLoRA，它注入参数化的奇异分量。
tldr: 本文提出SCLoRA方法，通过频谱裁剪控制LoRA适配器的奇异值增长，在提升学习能力的同时有效减少灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCLoRA, which uses spectral clipping to control singular value growth in LoRA adapters, enabling better learning while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
